name: Haagenti
wishes: a flared cross whose top arm is the entering stem and whose foot is a bell; rendered as cross plus tri
notes: Two long rails: the middle one between two rings, the lower one ending in a ring; a left post carrying a square bay topped by an outlined inverted triangle; two tall boxes standing from the lower rail through the middle rail, each followed by a ring on a stem, repeated; two stems from the middle rail through the lower rail to wide flared crosses on bell feet, repeated; a right post from a ring at its top corner down through both rails to a hanging ring.
